name: fi-yel-social
description: Compute ordinary Finnish self-employed social contributions for tax year 2026. Establish YEL eligibility and working-owner classification, confirmed annual work income, pension premiums, startup reduction, review transitions and insured-person health contributions. Use for YEL income, entrepreneur pension insurance, side businesses, family work, company-owner salaries, contribution flexibility and pension-payment deductions. Separates the pension provider's contribution from tax-collected health contributions, applies substituted YEL bases to prevent double charging, and links employee TyEL, unemployment and employer contributions to the payroll skill. Includes statutory source dates, filing/payment and neglect procedures and two recomputable examples. Individual benefit awards and MYEL agricultural/grant schemes require their own entitlement decisions.
